headline: Mooring County Burns Hardest as Lines Shift in the Expanse
war_summary: The furnace at Mooring County has not slackened since the last edition. Six events fell there in the past two hours, the latest just before this filing, and the ledger now reads eleven Warden works, one Colonial and none unclaimed, against nine, two and one at the previous count. The day's toll there stands at 5,941 Colonial and 5,254 Warden casualties, with the past hour's fire running at 441 and 506 respectively. The Weathered Expanse has shifted again to five Warden works, one Colonial and three unclaimed; fifty events were logged in the day and seventeen in six hours, with the heaviest casualties anywhere, 8,627 Colonial and 11,410 Warden, though the hourly pace is easing. Nevish Line holds at five Warden works to three Colonial but has lain silent since the last cutoff. Palantine Berm remains busy with thirty events in the day, while Callahan's Passage cools to five Colonial and twenty-seven Warden casualties an hour. Kuura Strand and Fisherman's Row, both lively earlier, are quiet this hour. Across 436 counted works the Colonials hold 306, the Wardens 125, and five lie unclaimed; no victory is declared on this, the 539th day, thirty-four towns still the mark.
